method: Read-only examination of the final file hashes; no additional tests or target execution by this reviewer.

resolved_findings.previous_risk: An offset absent from the complete opcode plan could enter the unselected-offset branch and return DISABLE without a gap.
resolved_findings.final_check: The callback checks an exact integer offset against the complete opcode mapping before intentional omission; unknown offsets emit INSTRUCTION_NOT_IN_VERIFIED_CODE and stop collection.

resolved_findings.previous_risk: The complete disassembly tuple was allocated before comparing the remaining static-plan budget.
resolved_findings.final_check: Disassembly is consumed incrementally, retaining at most the remaining instruction allowance and observing at most one extra item before rejecting.

resolved_findings.previous_risk: Error or stopped callbacks could return DISABLE after monitoring ownership was lost.
resolved_findings.final_check: The shared callback-result helper returns no DISABLE after known monitoring interference or a tool/global/local mask mismatch.

resolved_findings.previous_risk: Distinct live CodeType objects with the same descriptor shared plan cost but independently accumulated disabled-offset sets, multiplying retained state.
resolved_findings.final_check: A monotonic aggregate disabled-instruction counter is capped by max_events; exceeding it emits a specific gap and stops collection.

resolved_findings.previous_risk: Cleanup could clear masks after known interference, or skip a mismatched local mask but still free the tool slot.
resolved_findings.final_check: Both stop and child-side fork cleanup first collect installed live code objects and verify all local masks plus tool/global ownership; only a complete successful preflight permits cleanup. Known interference prevents these monitoring mutations.

other_checks: CALL continuation and exception-handler offsets belong to selected_offsets and stay monitored even when initially no attempt is pending.
Per-object monitoring state uses id plus weakref identity checks, remains bounded by the code-object ceiling, and preserves disabled offsets across inactive invocations.
Static windows reject internal jump and exception-handler entries; the selector walks instruction indexes rather than copying a prefix per CALL.
The existing GAP, hook-epoch, occurrence, budget and conditional-authority semantics remain required.
owner_reported_verification: Collector owner reported 22 targeted tests passing; this reviewer did not rerun them.
